app.name: VoiceDesk
bar.modelTitle: Language model reported by the agent CLI
notes.title: notes/
notes.emptyBody: No Markdown files yet. The first one appears when the agent writes it.
notes.noneBody: Your Markdown files will be listed here once a folder is set.
notes.foot: The agent writes these files. VoiceDesk never edits them itself.
turn.emptyBody: Hold to talk and say what you want written. Whatever the agent creates shows up in the list on the left.
talk.busy: One turn at a time — wait for the reply
err.mic.deniedBody: VoiceDesk needs the microphone to hear you. Turn it on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone, then quit and reopen the app — macOS applies the change to a running app only after it restarts.
err.mic.retryBody: Nothing was recorded. Hold the control again and allow access when macOS asks.
err.mic.noneBody: VoiceDesk could not find an input device. Connect one and try again.
err.emptyBody: The recording was silent. Hold the control and speak.
first.title: Two things, then you can talk
first.body: Hold the control, say what you want written, release. A coding agent does the writing.
first.micBody: VoiceDesk listens only while you hold the control. Nothing is captured between turns.
first.folderBody: The agent reads and writes the Markdown files here. VoiceDesk never edits them itself.
about.title: About VoiceDesk
about.body: VoiceDesk is an Electron app: the window is Chromium, the file work is Node. It therefore ships its own type rather than borrowing the system stack, and the notices below travel with it.
about.foot: Full licence texts ship with the sources, in package-lock.json and each package's own files.
